# opnsense_ipsec_manual_spd (Resource)

Manual IPsec security policy (SPD) entries (VPN > IPsec > Manual SPD), e.g. to route extra networks into a route-based tunnel's child SA.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# Also send 10.10.0.0/16 into the child SA with request ID 100.
resource "opnsense_ipsec_manual_spd" "extra" {
  request_id  = 100
  source      = "10.10.0.0/16"
  destination = "172.16.0.0/16"
  description = "Extra networks for site B"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `request_id` (Number) Request ID of the child SA to bind to: the `request_id` set on an `opnsense_ipsec_child`.
- `source` (String) Source network, e.g. `10.0.0.0/24`.

### Optional

- `connection_child` (String) UUID of an `opnsense_ipsec_child` to bind to. Defaults to `""`.
- `description` (String) Description. Defaults to `""`.
- `destination` (String) Destination network. Defaults to `""`.
- `enabled` (Boolean) Enable the entry. Defaults to `true`.
- `protocol` (String) `esp` or `ah`. Defaults to `esp`.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) UUID of the entry.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
# Import by UUID
terraform import opnsense_ipsec_manual_spd.example 00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000
```
